How Mymensingh became a hub of Language Movement
2023-02-27T20:27:57+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/how-mymensingh-became-hub-language-movement-3258846

Mymensingh was at the forefront among the districts of the then East Bengal in terms of contribution in the Language Movement. In December 1947, the heat of the movement spread across Mymensingh through a student meeting held at Bipin Park area of the city.

In the 71st year of the Language Movement, watch the background and history of the movement in Mymensingh in today's Star Special
